title: JonBenét Ramsey Americas Child Beauty Queen
note: Transcribed from the recording by faster-whisper (medium.en), primed with the names in the case and checked for their spelling. Wording may contain minor errors.

segments.text: The tragic story of JonBenét Ramsey is probably one of the most publicly known unsolved murder cases in the United States today. This story has more conspiracy theories than the moon landing, but no more main suspects than the Kennedy assassination. Well, I took the time to break down all the facts of the case and bring you all the latest updates, including the most recent one just this year.
On the murder of JonBenét Ramsey.
